status: Independent whole grammar structure census proposal; not extraction completion or canonical installation
method: All14 originals viewed sequentially, PDFs7–8 using existing original renders and9–20 using PDFium2.2x. One overwritten PNG retained; no OCR rerun. OCR lines are retrieval hints only, not accepted transcription.
count_policy: Counts refer to physical blocks/cells/quoted occurrences, not unique lexemes or final emitted rows. Repeated source quotations, base/suffix/output columns, slash alternatives and whole expressions require separate accounting. Counts with ambiguous column role are explicitly labelled; final glyph extraction must preserve that uncertainty. No total word count is inferred by adding heterogeneous measures.

mandatory_recovery_rules: Recover target-language definitions and examples embedded in Bengali prose, not only large tables.
Recover every explicit bound marker and root as morphology; zero markers and abstract grammatical variables remain typed controls.
Retain both the complete source expression and explicitly printed analytical components; do not invent absent stems or spread whole translations onto every component.
Parenthetical Bengali and English usually provide glosses/control; slash-separated Bengali glosses are not target variants.
Resolve across-page headings before assigning person, number, tense or case; keep literal pronouns when source headings conflict.
Preserve repeated groups, missing cells, duplicated side-column forms and irregular label placements as physical evidence before any exact-analysis reuse.
Affix combinations and grammatical restrictions should be represented source-specifically; comparison/format similarity does not justify variant or derivation edges.
Every original glyph still needs extraction/review; this structure census is not a complete lexical transcript.
